title: DOC Claim Bar
description: One claim in two weights, a short body line and a CTA bar
useWhen: DOC has one claim to make (a setup and its payoff) and an action to take.
notWhen: the piece is about one number (use `DOC Stat Hero`) or a date (use `DOC Save the Date`).
guidance: headline-1 is the setup, in Regular; headline-2 the payoff, in Bold ("Dental school taught you teeth." / "We teach you business."). Each about two lines; break at a sense unit so the weight change lands at a line end.
body: one or two lines, two sense units broken after the comma. Optional.
cta-line sets up the CTA verb in the bar ("Enrollment is open." before "Enroll now"); cta-eyebrow is a short label above it, optional.
Copy in US English, in the DOC voice: plain, specific, second person, no exclamation marks. Never invent a figure, price, date, module count, quote or name.

Themes: Foundations, Startup and Acquisition are the three tracks (red, purple, green grounds): use the one the piece is about, never mix tracks. Dark and Light are neutral, for the collective as a whole.

cta: no full stop. By theme: Foundations "Join the waitlist" (Foundations only), Startup "Enroll now", Acquisition "Register now", Dark "Apply today", Light "Get started" — unless the brief gives its own action.
